children: The Nikkei Stock Average falls 2.9% to 65755.28, tracking Wall Street's losses overnight. The U.S. inflation report released Wednesday "revived expectations of another interest rate hike by the Fed," XS.com's Antonio Di Giacomo says in an email. "Higher price pressures, elevated yields, and concerns about technology companies reduced risk appetite," the senior market analyst adds. Among the worst performers on Japan's benchmark index, Ibiden drops slides 9.8%, Fujikura falls 8.6%, and Kioxia Holdings drops 8.2%. The dollar is at 157.86 yen versus Y158.30 around Wednesday's Tokyo market close. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
